intro.h2: One remodeler for the whole room, not just one trade
paragraphs: Kelly's Kitchen and Bath does complete kitchen and bath remodeling. Kelly handles the demo, then the work most remodels need but few people want to coordinate: tearing out part of a wall, relocating the fridge, new floors, lighting, cabinets, appliances and fixtures. Bathrooms get the same whole-room approach, whether it is a full master bath or a hall bath that needs a new floor and vanity.

Reviewers call Kelly a true craftsman: personable, knowledgeable and clearly experienced. One homeowner who had heard remodeling horror stories from friends says Kelly made a stressful kitchen remodel easy, and another says he could not be happier with the work Kelly and Mark did on two of his bathrooms.

items.name: Complete kitchen remodels
items.blurb: Kitchens completely gutted and rebuilt. One kitchen now has white shaker cabinets, subway tile, a black range hood, an island and pendant lights. Kelly handles the demo, the layout changes and the install, so you deal with one remodeler from start to finish.

image.alt: Remodeled galley kitchen with white subway tile, black wall-mounted range hood, white cabinets and wood-look floor

items.name: Bathroom renovations
items.blurb: Full master bath renovations and smaller updates like a new floor, vanity and fixtures in a hall bath. One master bath pairs a freestanding tub with a backlit mirror and a dark vanity, and a 2023 project added luxurious gold accents throughout.

image.alt: Master bathroom with white freestanding tub, backlit mirror over a dark vanity and white plantation shutters

items.name: Cabinets and countertops
items.blurb: Cabinet installation comes up more than any other job in their Google reviews. Kelly's Kitchen and Bath installs cabinets and countertops, from bright white shaker kitchens to black cabinets with a dark marble-look top, gold hardware and under-cabinet lighting.

image.alt: Black cabinets with dark marble-look countertop and backsplash, gold faucet and pulls, and under-cabinet lighting

items.name: Walls, floors, lighting and appliances
items.blurb: The parts that turn a cabinet job into a real remodel. Reviewers describe walls partly taken out, a fridge relocated, new flooring, new lighting and appliances all installed by Kelly. Wall tear-outs, flooring repair and appliance installation all appear in review topics.

image.alt: Open kitchen with island, pendant lights and new floor in a remodel where part of a wall was taken out

items.title: The timeline holds
items.text: Scott B. says everything Kelly told them from the start about timing and installation was spot on, through a full gut, wall removal and fridge relocation.

items.title: Experience you can tell
items.text: Michael M. found Kelly very personable and knowledgeable and says you could tell he was very experienced. He had Kelly do both the demo and installation.

items.title: Good product advice
items.text: Mark M. says the products Kelly recommended for his master bath and hall bath all look and work great, with attention to every detail.

items.title: Fair, not cheapest
items.text: In Mark M.'s words, Kelly was not the low bid but far from the highest. Google shows a 5.0 star rating from 8 reviews.

about.text: Kelly's Kitchen and Bath is run by Kelly, a remodeler customers describe as a true craftsman who is personable, knowledgeable and very experienced. He works with a dedicated team, including Mark, whom one customer thanked by name for his bathroom work. Kelly takes on whole projects rather than single trades: demolition, wall changes, flooring, lighting, cabinets, countertops, appliances and fixtures. At the start of each new year, the company's Facebook page thanks its customers, team and community for another year of projects.

image.alt: Master bathroom remodeled by Kelly's Kitchen and Bath, with freestanding tub and backlit mirror

process.h2: How a remodel with Kelly works

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: Call (636) 697-0380 or email kelly@kellyskandb.com. Kelly listens to what you want and lays out the plan and timing from the start.

steps.title: Choose products
steps.text: Kelly recommends cabinets, counters, fixtures and finishes that look good and work well, then you decide together.

steps.title: Demo and rebuild
steps.text: The old room is gutted. Walls and appliance locations change where needed, then floors, lighting and cabinets go in.

steps.title: Finish and walkthrough
steps.text: Appliances and fixtures are installed and you walk the finished room, on the timeline you were given at the start.

service_area.text: Kelly's Kitchen and Bath does not list a street address or service area on its Google profile, so the quickest way to check is to ask. Call (636) 697-0380 between 8 AM and 5 PM, Monday to Friday, or email kelly@kellyskandb.com with your town and a short description of the kitchen or bathroom you want to remodel, and Kelly will let you know.

items.q: Do you handle the whole remodel or just cabinets?
items.a: The whole remodel. Customers describe Kelly gutting a kitchen, taking out part of a wall, relocating the fridge and installing floors, lighting, cabinets and appliances. In bathrooms he has done complete master bath renovations as well as smaller floor, vanity and fixture updates.

items.q: Will the project stay on schedule?
items.a: Reviewers say it did. One customer says everything Kelly told them from the start about timing and installation was spot on, and that he made a stressful kitchen remodel easy. Ask Kelly for the timeline for your own project when you first talk.

Prices are not published, since every remodel is different. One customer who collected several bids says Kelly was not the low bid but far from the highest bids, and that the products Kelly recommended all look and work great. Call to talk about your project and budget.

Call (636) 697-0380 or email kelly@kellyskandb.com. Google lists hours Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday. You can also see recent projects on the Kelly's Kitchen and Bath Facebook and Instagram pages before you call.

items.q: Do you install appliances and flooring too?
items.a: Yes. Appliance installation, flooring repair, cabinet installation and wall tear-outs all come up in Google review topics. One kitchen got new floors, lighting, cabinets and appliances in the same project, so you do not need separate crews for each part.

final_cta.h2: Planning a kitchen or bathroom remodel?
final_cta.text: Call Kelly to talk about your plans and timeline.
